title: Billing Desk Schedule: Prepaid Pass Late-Cancellation Fee Amount
content:
**Tailwise Grooming Salon — amount of the pass late-cancellation fee on prepaid passes** (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom and Spa Groom passes).

**Schedule entry.** The pass late-cancellation fee is the pass's late-cancellation fee figure on the salon's cancellation terms for that pass, rounded half up to the cent once on the final amount.

**Rounding.** The amount is carried unrounded until the final figure, and only the final amount is rounded, half up to the cent. Half up means a figure lying exactly on a half cent goes to the higher cent; to that end a tolerance of 0.0001 cent is added to the final amount before it is rounded.

**Inputs and their records**

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| which pass the fee is booked against | the pass record (pass name) |
| the pass's late-cancellation fee figure | the cancellation terms for that pass name |

**Worked through (hypothetical)**

- A prepaid pass whose late-cancellation fee figure is 20.00: the pass late-cancellation fee is 20.00.
- A prepaid pass whose late-cancellation fee figure is 15.00: the pass late-cancellation fee is 15.00.
- An unrounded amount of 18.745 lies exactly on a half cent and is booked as 18.75; an unrounded 18.7449 is booked as 18.74.
